title: Agents observe and act
summary: An agent is a system that observes a situation and chooses an action. It needs clear allowed actions and a way to check what happened.
introduction: An agent is a system that observes a situation and chooses an action. It needs clear allowed actions and a way to check what happened. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An agent is a system that observes a situation and chooses an action. It needs clear allowed actions and a way to check what happened.

blocks.code:
Observe: shelf count is zero
Suggest: ask when a book may return
Human checks: is the shelf count current?
Allowed action in this demo: show a suggestion
blocks.title: Agents observe and act

blocks.text: The system reads a count and suggests a next step. It does not send messages or alter a real library record.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write one condition that should stop an action.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Giving a system an action tool is different from merely asking it for advice.
For more detail later, use this [Artificial Intelligence further reading](https://ai4k12.org/resources/).
